entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lubbertus Götzen was a Dutch accountant and politician. He embarked upon a civil service career in the Dutch East Indies. He was a minister of the Department of Finance. In Indonesia he was politically active in the Christian political party.

entities.summary: Lubbertus Götzen was a Dutch accountant and politician. He embarked upon a civil service career in the Dutch East Indies. He was a minister of the Department of Finance. In Indonesia he was politically active in the Christian political party.
